limitations.note: The square-wave counter still rolls over at 20 rather than 19, leaving the 21-clock period in place instead of producing equal 10-clock high and low phases.
The rewrite forces the output low when entering square mode before the first scheduled transition, whereas the correct fix preserves the previous output until that transition.

The rewritten triangle logic starts by incrementing after reset or entry at a midrange value, whereas the correct fix preserves the original initial decrement and changes only the upper reversal threshold.
The test encoded the rewrite's 21-clock square period, immediate clearing on square-mode entry, and ascending triangle startup, so it passed without detecting the timing and mode-switch mismatches.
